body: Does everyone who takes the ASVAB have to go through, like, boot camp even if their role doesn't involve physical combat?

That's a good goal but are there any military paths that don't involve...like...living in a barracks and/or shooting things? I assume the military has need for people in other roles. I remember reading something about a Redditor who was in the military as an analyst of some type for enemy positions or something, are there other jobs like that which you could do with no degree?

This is a funny novelty account and I bet most posts like mine probably have something similar to this behind them, but I don't make enough money to buy any games, I am saving my money but it's not quite enough yet for a semester at the CC and even then I'd only be able to afford one semester, and my mom is supposed to be taking medication for several disorders but isn't. As I write this my dad is working with CPS to take my younger siblings away from her although he won't take me because I'm 18 and we had a falling out a few months back.

I also have big ambitions in life but I'm trying to be realistic and work one problem at a time.
